verdict.rationale: The open-source library is explicitly positioned for automating the web 'from your own code, and with any LLM' (browser-use-gh-3, docs-19), and the Cloud API supports fully programmatic, headless task execution via client.runs.create with pollable events for monitoring (docs-1, docs-5, docs-14) — both suit CI/automation use. Missing for 10: independent hands-on CI-pipeline example/case study confirming headless run in an actual CI system, and explicit headless-mode configuration documentation for the OSS library.
